description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for handling platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWRT-based environment. It manages boot device identification, image verification, partition layout comparisons, and system upgrades including flash operations and configuration copying.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Identifies the boot device based on the current kernel command line and sets environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the partition layout of the uploaded firmware image against the current device to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing the new image to the appropriate device and updating boot configurations.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data into the boot partition of the device.
